doc.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Higgins as friend and the Acoustic Masters record
summary: He describes Higgins's selflessness, their trio sessions, and Higgins calling him acki and saying let's go steady.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Higgins was the most compassionate being, and all these cats was always askin’ him for bread and stuff, you know, and “Aww, I need a transmission on my car...” “I need this”, and he was a selfless man. He’d just get people whatever they wanted. And he was selfless and he... you know. I remember... Higgins and I were close, man. See, because that record, Acoustic Masters that we made - it was around early ‘90s, someone called and wanted me to do a project, and I said, Higgins, Ron Carter, and Cedar. Course I knew they had a trio and I like hearin’ them, and so I was gonna voscillate with that. But Carter had some demands or somethin’ that didn’t work with what they were... so what’s his name came in - Buster came and played the bass. But they... So Higgins said

that we should do something together. Anyway, Cedar was going into Catalinas and so they called and asked me would I make a separate arrangement and come in and play with them. But Higgins and I always had this beautiful chemistry.

And so Higgins and I - we’d play together in that formation from time to time, and then I remember Higgins said - He called me acki, that’s brother. He said, “Acki, let’s stop datin’ and go steady.” [Laughs] You know.
Yeah, so whenever I’d go out he would always go with me, you know.
Because we were playing down at the Warner Theater, something down there.
And Pennent Pidro, that’s my hood!

And I was - I know that I was speakin’ on the microphone and I was crying about Master Higgins was back, and he said, “Acki, I didn’t know you felt like that.” He said, “let’s stop dating”. He said, “let’s go steady.”

And then he also taught me something, which is along the lines of what you were asking me about. Which he experienced more than that. He said "If you have a group of guys who believe in a concept who are there in a relationship," he said "the world can't mess with that."
That's what I said in the film.
